kills.change_summary: Change the require that forbids zero address to instead allow zero address by removing the require and returning balances[address(0)][id] (i.e., delete the require check), so balanceOf(address(0), id) no longer reverts and returns stored value.

kills.change_summary: Invert the zero-address check so that calling balanceOf with a non-zero account reverts instead, changing returned values for any normal account.
